captions.title: Customize, from the menu
captions.line: It opens the live site, exactly as visitors see it.

captions.title: Mark up, then scroll to it
captions.line: Find the part of the page you want changed.

captions.title: Freeze this screen
captions.line: It takes a picture of exactly what you are looking at.

captions.title: Frame what you mean
captions.line: Circle, arrow, box or pen. Use as many as you need.

captions.title: Say what should be different
captions.line: One clear sentence saves the developer a guess.

captions.title: Saved for the developer
captions.line: They can mark it In progress or Done, and reply in the thread.
